source.title: KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD)
source.citation: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD-MBD Update Work Group. KDIGO 2017 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for the Diagnosis, Evaluation, Prevention, and Treatment of Chronic Kidney Disease–Mineral and Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD). Kidney Int Suppl. 2017;7:1–59.

governing_source_gap: The required project files literature.py, literature_atoms.py, literature_atom.schema.json, README(2).md, and example_atom.json were not retrievable from the connected Drive/File Library during this run. Structural validation therefore used a Pydantic contract reconstructed from recent validated project artifacts; sufficiency checks applied the explicit rules available in large-source-ATOM-SEA.md. This is not represented as execution of the unavailable governing Python implementation.
consistency_findings: All atoms share one publication_id across the guideline, evidence tables, and appendices.
Supplemental evidence findings are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to the KDIGO packet rather than represented as primary-study data.
The September 2017 Supplemental Table 21 comparator correction is preserved as a source-level atom.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; formal guidance is represented with atom_kind=other and descriptive tags, following the large-source guideline guardrail.
extraction_limitations: Bibliography entries were not atomized; references are provenance infrastructure.
Evidence tables were summarized at evidence-profile and load-bearing result level rather than converting every cell of all 55 supplemental tables into an atom.
Primary-study results cited by the guideline remain secondary reports unless the primary publication is separately extracted.
